label: hAP ac
description: MikroTik hAP ac (RB962UiGS-5HacT2HnT) — 5x 1G RJ45, 1x SFP, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz + 5 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9558.
notes: Inlet is eth1, outlet eth5. https://manual.mikrotik.com/hardware/hap-ac/ (read 2026-11-28): "The board accepts power from the power jack or from the first Ethernet port (Passive PoE) ... First Ethernet port accepts passive Power over Ethernet accepts 11-57 V DC ... The Ether 5 port supports PoE output ... up to 0.7 A". https://mikrotik.com/product/RB962UiGS-5HacT2HnT: PoE in Passive PoE, PoE in input Voltage 11-57 V, PoE-out ports Ether5, PoE-Out current limit 700 mA, Max power consumption 17 W. The sheet publishes no without-attachments row, so 17 W is the published ceiling - the own draw of the board plus whatever it passes on. eth2-eth4 are poeIn: false; eth5 sources.
